comment: Migrate component styling from Griffel to Tailwind CSS + CSS Modules. Styles now ship as a per-package stylesheet compiled to dist/styles.css instead of being injected at runtime: bundler consumers load it automatically through the package's ESM side-effect import, SSR/CommonJS consumers import the ./styles.css subpath, and apps load @fluentui/react-tailwind-theme/styles.css once at the document root. The BEM static class names previously published on component internals are no longer rendered; the *ClassNames constants are retained and marked deprecated for compile compatibility, with the root entry remaining each component's public identity class.
